sample_seed_rule: stable_seed(base_seed, 'generate', model_dataset, train_seed); one device generator draws x_T (uniform over 51 classes) and then every reverse step
distance: Hamming distance over the 64 decoded tokens; transposed: pitch tokens of the generated window shifted by -12..+12 semitones (pitches leaving 38-86 never match), minimum over shifts; ties keep the first training window and the lowest shift
